# Neptune - Fitness & Nutrition: legal pages

The public Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Trainer Terms and Coaching Data Sharing Consent for Neptune - Fitness & Nutrition, served by GitHub Pages at https://jhpaluso.github.io/neptune-legal/.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are generated from the same text the app shows (`lib/data/legal/` in the app repo) by `tool/legal_pages/export_legal_pages_test.dart`; see `docs/features/legal-and-consent.md#public-web-pages` there.
